reviews.title: Dishonest, misleading and completely incompetent customer service
reviews.body:
Dishonest, misleading and completely incompetent customer service

I rarely leave one-star reviews, but my experience with Lebara has been so appalling that I feel compelled to warn others.

Following the theft of my iPhone, I needed a simple proof of usage certificate to progress my insurance claim. What should have been a routine administrative request has turned into an absolute nightmare.

Despite responding to Lebara’s requests for documentation THREE times, their customer service representatives continue to tell me to reply to the same emails I’ve already answered. Nobody appears to read the correspondence, investigate the issue or take any responsibility for resolving it.

What I find particularly unacceptable is the repeated misleading information and empty assurances. I’m continually told to wait another 24–48 hours, yet nobody can explain what is actually happening, whether my documents have been reviewed or why the certificate hasn’t been issued.

I’ve raised a formal complaint, but even that has achieved seemingly nothing. My requests for escalation to a senior complaints manager have gone unanswered, and customer service representatives simply repeat the same scripted responses.

At this point, I genuinely question whether the information being provided to customers is truthful. There is a difference between making a mistake and repeatedly giving assurances without any apparent basis for them. Whether this is deliberate dishonesty or sheer incompetence, the outcome is the same.

Meanwhile, I’m unable to progress my insurance claim for a stolen phone because Lebara cannot provide a basic document.

The most concerning part is that when something genuinely goes wrong, customers appear to have no effective route to getting help. You are passed around, given generic responses and expected to accept endless delays.

Lebara may offer cheap mobile plans, but the true cost becomes apparent when you actually need customer support.

I have completely lost confidence in this company. The lack of accountability, transparency and basic competence is staggering.

My advice: avoid Lebara if you value reliable customer service. I certainly wouldn’t recommend them to anyone.

I will update this review if Lebara finally resolves the issue, but based on my experience so far, they deserve nothing more than one star.

reviews.title: Lost my number in a port and nobody will fix it
reviews.body:
First time ive gone with lebara and its been a nightmare.
 A port number was meant to be first part of Oct still not happened
Every time I phone Lebara I'm told the same thing: "give us 48 hours" or "give us one hour and we'll call you back." The call-back never comes, the 48 hours pass, and nothing changes. I've lost count of how many times I've explained the issue from scratch to a new person. Some times the Customer support just end the call. 
Losing a phone number isn't a small inconvenience. It's tied to my bank, my work and the people who need to reach me. What I needed was someone to take ownership, actually chase it and keep me updated. Instead I've had empty promises and silence.
If you're thinking of porting a number to or from Lebara, be very careful. When something goes wrong, don't expect anyone to follow through.

reviews.title: Not all it's cracked up to be.
reviews.body:
The company states that a new plan will run alongside an old plan until either it's data runs out or the date expires.
This isn't the case and no matter how I tell customer service they seem incapable of sorting out the problem.
I had a 50gb plan with 4gb left on it and 3 weeks left before it expired . I took out a 100gb plan to run alongside because I didn't want to run out of data as I don't have access to broadband WiFi. The new plan started using data immediately whereas the old plan remained the same. It seems with Lebara you don't have a problem until there's a problem and then seem incapable of sorting it.
